mechanism: A binary counter whose digits sit at unary gaps inside a bouncer; each bounce is +1. At each overflow the carry runs into the right counter RC (gap-1 R digits plus a tail). The tail counts overflows and decides each one: a 2-bit front unit cycles 10->01->11->{00 | 10}. The 11->10 wrap is a SILENT overflow: the counter wraps, the lead gains 1 and there is no pause. Every other overflow starts a pause (the wall/zone process of round 1), and the 0->1 flips of the front bit add one R digit. The tail is five fixed units plus an end unit (0?)^m 01. The end unit changes only at long, Fibonacci-like intervals, and it gains one '0?' (right edge +2) when it fills. With the true tail sequence the macro model is perfectly regular: silent overflows land only in normal mode, and after each one the pause has POs at p = 2^x+5, 2^y+2, 8 (new gap 7). Round 3: the proof does not need the silent schedule. The tail stays in a regular language L* (closed for every bit setting) whose front unit follows TAILFRONT, and under every TAILFRONT outcome sequence the macro arithmetic keeps the interval invariant above, so no degenerate parameter appears.

rules.name: P100
rules.cases: b0=0, v+2<2^N; j = lowest index>=1 with bit 0

rules.name: P010
rules.cases: Y any wall prefix seen in the run

rules.name: NO
rules.cases: T not the silent state; D_R(0) T' depends only on T

rules.name: SILENT
rules.cases: only the tail state seen at step 1.45e7

rules.name: TAILFRONT
rules.from: front unit (c-78,c-76) of the tail at an overflow
rules.to: 10->01 (NO, e0), 01->11 (NO, e1), 11->00 (NO, e0), 00->10 (NO, e1), 11->10 (SILENT, e0); which of 11->00 / 11->10 happens depends on the rest of the tail

rules.name: SILENTP
rules.cases: tail in a silent state; n>=0, p>=0

rules.name: NO/PO steps
rules.cases: RC fixed (C = 248 / 258 for the RC before overflow 7)

rules.name: L*-CLOSURE
rules.to: N or S, new RC in L* with m or m+1; front unit (y,z) and emission follow TAILFRONT

rules.name: ENDCARRY
rules.from: fixed bits all 1, end bits 1^j 0 rest (or 1^m)
rules.to: j even: N, (10)^(j/2) 1 rest; j odd: S, (01)^((j+1)/2) rest; 1^m as j=m+1 with growth
rules.cases: m=9..60, random r, a, large gaps

rules.name: NOCARRY
rules.to: as the m=3 table; end bits unchanged (head stays >= 6 cells left of the end unit)
rules.cases: m=9..60, random r, a, large gaps

rules.name: TAIL-PO-CONTEXT
rules.from: PO / SILENTP start with an L* tail
rules.to: same new RC as the NO / SILENT start

rules.name: MACRO-INV
rules.from: normal-mode overflow in the invariant set
rules.to: next normal-mode overflow in the invariant set via S / P1 / P1S / P3

round2_remaining_gaps: General tail rule. The carry through the five fixed units is finite: it has been observed for 40,000 overflows but not enumerated over all unit states. The end unit (0?)^m 01 has no parametric rule. Its changes come at overflows 3313, 5361, 7009, 9057 | 14801, 18497, 20545, 22193, 24241 | 33681, 39425, with gaps 2048, 1648, 2048 | 5744, 3696, 2048, 1648, 2048 | 9440, 5744. These gaps satisfy F(n) = F(n-1) + F(n-2), which suggests a Zeckendorf-style counter. Its growth rule (m -> m+1) is seen only twice

No closed form yet for the macro dynamics as a function of the tail count. Observed (8,000 overflows, not proven): silent overflows are 7 or 11 apart, and after each silent the pause has exactly three POs with p = 2^x+5, 2^y+2 and 8. A proof needs this as an induction over super-cycles
The pause rules (ZX/ZXP) at small parameters are unvalidated: a zone of 1 or 2 blocks, or ZXP with n < 3. They are unreachable per the macro model, which is evidence but not a proof
C_NO(RC) and C_PO(RC), the tail-dependent constants in the NO/PO step counts, have no formula. They are needed only for Rocq step accounting

Macro invariant, proved by interval arithmetic from the macro model: at every normal-mode overflow (M=2^N, c=D(G,R)-4, s=a-c, f=front unit), f=11 and 24<=s<=M/4+2, or f=10 and s in [8,M-14] or [M+24,2M]; c=M/4+kappa, kappa in {2,8}. Only four paths between normal-mode overflows (P1 from either f): S (s+M), P1 (4M, M+10-s), P1S (4M, 5M+10-s), P3 (32M, 9M+32-s).
